title: Copley Acquisition Corp Announces Shareholder Approval of Extension of Termination Date and Contribution to Trust Account to Extend Termination Date
Copley Acquisition Corp Seeks Extension of Merger Deadline
Copley Acquisition Corp., Ignite Proteomics Call Off Merger
Ignite Proteomics LLC cancelled the acquisition of Copley Acquisition Corp from Copley Acquisition Sponsors, LLC and others in a reverse merger transaction.
